record.question: He considers the new assignment as more challenging than much of the other assignments.
record.explanation: Answer A: most of the other. “More challenging than most of the other assignments” compares one assignment with the majority of the remaining assignments. Independent check: “More challenging than most of the other assignments” is the grammatical comparison; “much of the other assignments” is not. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/much-many-a-lot-of-lots-of. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
